coverage.note: T2 and D-202–D-204 cover exact help output, absent names, formatting bypass and terminator behavior through FR-201-AC1/AC2.
T1 supplies the translation module and backward-compatible greet interface; T2 adds CLI coverage. Literal expected translations make acceptance independent of production greeting logic.
D-202/D-203 and T2 cover missing, unsupported and repeated invalid language values, own-key rejection and option-error precedence over help.
D-204 and T2 specify all eight modifier combinations per language, default English JSON metadata, ordering, repetition and escaped-name round trips.

D-205 and T2 preserve unaffected assertions and one-argument serialization. Inspected source/tests support the identified compatibility changes; write scopes exclude dependencies, README and workflows. Passing tests and scope review remain explicit completion gates.

simplerAlternative: No materially simpler design is needed. The small translation module and sequential T1 → T2 integration fit the required module boundary and keep ownership clear without additional infrastructure.
